function mP(e, t) {
  const n = e.width * e.tileSize, l = e.height * e.tileSize, a = Math.min(t.w / n, t.h / l), o = n * a, s = l * a, r = t.x + (t.w - o) / 2, i = t.y + (t.h - s) / 2;
  return Object.freeze({
    scale: a,
    rect: Object.freeze({ x: r, y: i, w: o, h: s }),
    worldToDisplay(u, d) {
      return [r + u * a, i + d * a];
    },
    displayToWorld(u, d) {
      return u < r || d < i || u >= r + o || d >= i + s ? null : [(u - r) / a, (d - i) / a];
    },
    tileCenterToDisplay(u, d, p = 0, g = 0) {
      return this.worldToDisplay((u - p) * 16 + 8, (d - g) * 16 + 8);
    }
  });
}
